description:
Brand introduction:
GLOWSCAPES is a brand that focuses on creative home lighting. We bring consumers a personalized luminous experience through innovative design and quality manufacturing. Our products include 3D creative night lights in various styles, suitable for young people between 18-45 years old who are seeking a unique home atmosphere. Our design team continues to innovate and strive to create products that combine unique visual effects with functionality in the field of lighting, aiming to add warm, dreamy light and shadow effects to every space. GLOWSCAPES not only focuses on aesthetics, but also pays attention to the practicality and durability of products. With strict factory production standards and innovative research and development, it has become the preferred brand in many homes, offices and gift markets.

Product description:
GLOWSCAPES 'products are a series of highly creative 3D night lights that combine modern design with advanced lighting technology. Each night light uses high-quality transparent acrylic panels and advanced LED light sources to form a unique visual effect. The lamps can be adjusted according to personal needs through simple switch or touch-sensitive control, and are suitable for placement in various indoor spaces such as bedrooms, study rooms, living rooms, etc. The design inspiration of the products comes from a variety of elements such as nature, technology, animation, etc., to ensure that each product can meet the aesthetic needs of different consumers.

Lighting effects: Soft and unobtrusive, providing comfortable night lighting to create a relaxing and peaceful environment.
Applicable scenarios: suitable for home, office, coffee shop, study and other spaces, or as a creative gift.
Product size and color: Each lamp has multiple sizes and colors to choose from, allowing users to choose the most suitable style according to their needs.
Unique selling points:
Innovative design: Each night light is carefully crafted by a team of professional designers, with unique creativity, both artistic and practical, giving the space a unique light and shadow effect.

Versatile and environmentally friendly: We use high-efficiency LED bulbs that are energy-efficient and have a long lifespan, minimizing energy consumption. The products are made of environmentally friendly materials, which are safe and harmless, and are suitable for families and children.

Customization options: Some products offer customized design services, allowing consumers to choose colors, brightness, or patterns according to their needs to create their own personalized night lights.

Widely used: suitable for a variety of scenarios such as home, office, bar, coffee shop, gift market, etc., with great market potential and suitable for various consumer needs.

Payment terms:
Commission structure: We offer a commission ratio based on the sales amount. For every successful referral of an order, the partner will receive 10-15% commission. The specific ratio can be adjusted according to the sales performance and the partner's situation.

Settlement cycle: Settlement is conducted once a month, and the commission will be paid to the account provided by the partner within 15 working days after the end of the month.

Payment method: Support bank transfer, PayPal and other payment methods.

Return Policy: If the product is returned due to product quality problems, the commission will be adjusted according to the actual return situation. All returns must meet our return policy standards.

Other information:
Marketing support: We provide our affiliate partners with comprehensive marketing activity support, including high-quality product images, marketing copy, social media materials, etc., to help partners improve sales results.

Tracking and reporting: Each partner will receive exclusive tracking links and analytics tools to help track promotion effectiveness and commission revenue in real time.

Promotions: We regularly organize limited-time discounts, festival promotions, and other activities, allowing our partners to participate in these activities and enjoy more sales incentives.

Priority Collaboration: High-performing partners will have the opportunity to receive exclusive collaboration opportunities, special offers, or early access to new products.
